jp_verse: 差し出した舌の先に\n\n    言葉になる前の　本音が揺れていた
en_verse: At the tip of the outstretched tongue,\ntruth trembled before becoming words.

jp_verse: 木の升に　白い米が満ち\n\n    静かな暮らしの重みが　そこに宿っていた
en_verse: The wooden measure brimmed with white rice,\nholding the quiet weight of daily life.

jp_verse: 朝焼けの空へ　気球が浮かび\n\n    心まで少しずつ　高くなっていった
en_verse: A hot-air balloon rose into the dawn sky,\nand the heart itself slowly lifted higher.

jp_verse: 円い光の中に　静かな影が立ち\n\n    終わりなき輪が　夜を包んでいた
en_verse: Within the circle of light stood a silent figure,\nwhile an endless ring embraced the night.

jp_verse: 「あと少しだけ」と囁く声に\n\n    人の欲望の長さが　測られていた
en_verse: In the whisper of \just a little more
column4: \"\nthe measure of human desire was revealed."

jp_verse: 頬杖をつく静かな午後\n\n    言葉にならぬ疲れが　机へ沈んでいた
en_verse: On a quiet afternoon resting upon her elbow,\nunspoken weariness sank into the table.

jp_verse: 使い込まれた道具のそばで\n\n    長い年月だけが　本当の技を育てていた
en_verse: Beside the well-worn tools,\nonly long years had nurtured true skill.

jp_verse: 本に囲まれた静かな部屋で\n\n    深い知識が　ゆっくりと言葉を選んでいた
en_verse: In the quiet room surrounded by books,\ndeep knowledge slowly chose its words.

jp_verse: 小さな枝が　石の上に立ち\n\n    誰かの通った印が　風に残っていた
en_verse: A small branch stood upon the stones,\nleaving behind the sign of someone's passing.

jp_verse: 暗い布の向こうで　水晶が光り\n\n    まだ来ぬ運命が　静かに覗いていた
en_verse: Beyond the dark cloth the crystal glowed,\nwhile unseen fate quietly peered ahead.

jp_verse: 青空へ伸びる凧を見上げ\n\n    少年の願いまで　風に昇っていった
en_verse: Watching the kite climb into the blue sky,\nthe boy's wishes rose with the wind.

jp_verse: 机の下から　猫が見上げ\n\n    小さな世界が　足元で息づいていた
en_verse: From beneath the table the cat looked upward,\nand a small hidden world quietly breathed below.

jp_verse: 黄色い卓の上に　一輪の花\n\n    何気ない場所が　静かに際立っていた
en_verse: Upon the yellow table stood a single flower,\nmaking an ordinary place quietly remarkable.

jp_verse: 霧の野を越えて　朝日が昇り\n\n    眠っていた世界を　黄金に染めていった
en_verse: The morning sun rose beyond the misty field,\nturning the sleeping world to gold.

jp_verse: 笑い声の奥に　小さな棘があり\n\n    人を傷つける影が　軽く揺れていた
en_verse: Behind the laughter hid a tiny thorn,\nand the shadow that wounds others gently stirred.

jp_verse: 唇の前に立てた一本の指\n\n    「ただそれだけ」が　静かに空気を変えていた
en_verse: A single finger raised before the lips,\nand \only this\" quietly changed the room."

jp_verse: 小さな貝殻を　指でつまみながら\n\n    遠い海の記憶が　微笑みの中に残っていた
en_verse: Holding the tiny shell between her fingers,\nthe memory of distant seas lingered in her smile.

jp_verse: 幼い声が　部屋いっぱいに響き\n\n    単純な歌が　夕暮れを明るくしていた
en_verse: A child's voice echoed through the room,\nand a simple song brightened the evening.

jp_verse: 群衆の前に　静かに立ちながら\n\n    曲げぬ信念だけが　胸に灯っていた
en_verse: Standing quietly before the crowd,\nonly unwavering conviction burned within her heart.

jp_verse: 胸の名札を整えながら\n\n    今日も誰かのために　笑顔を差し出していた
en_verse: Straightening the badge upon his chest,\nhe offered his smile once more for others today.
